history.summary: ISKCON Faridabad's presiding deities are Sri Sri Radha Govind, housed at Geeta Bhawan, C Block, Ashoka Enclave Part II, Sector 37. Justdial lists its year of establishment as 2008 ('18 years in business'); the temple runs daily aartis, Janmashtami and Rath Yatra celebrations, and has prasad/book counters and a vegetarian cafeteria. Coordinates are a full-address geocode match, agreeing with the temple's own Facebook location pin (28.4777, 77.3137). No conflicts beyond the usual listing-level detail.

name: ISKCON Faridabad
town_description: Faridabad is the largest city in Haryana and part of the National Capital Region, an industrial hub founded in 1607 by Sufi saint Sheikh Farid (Baba Farid). It lies about 25 km south of Delhi on NH-19 (Mathura Road).

travel.airport: IGI Airport, Delhi (~35 km via NH-19)
travel.railway: Faridabad New Town / Faridabad railway station (~4-6 km)
travel.road: Sarai metro station (Violet Line) nearby; on the Sector 37 bypass road

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Janmashtami for the main festival
